# Frame

A framed container for grouping related information.

Exports from `uiofcraft` and `uiofcraft/frame`: `Frame`, `FrameDescription`, `FrameFooter`, `FrameHeader`, `FramePanel`, `FrameTitle`.

## Usage

```tsx
import {
  Frame,
  FrameDescription,
  FrameFooter,
  FrameHeader,
  FramePanel,
  FrameTitle,
} from "uiofcraft"
```

```tsx
<Frame>
  <FrameHeader>
    <FrameTitle>Title</FrameTitle>
    <FrameDescription>Description</FrameDescription>
  </FrameHeader>
  <FramePanel>Content</FramePanel>
  <FrameFooter>Footer</FrameFooter>
</Frame>
```

| `className` | `string` |         |
